title: HD Video Downloader
summary: Download any videos in HD quality from internet at a click of a button.
description:
HD Video Downloader  - The top and best video downloader app for popular social media sites on PlayStore.

Ever come across any nice/funny/viral videos while browsing the internet and wish you could take it with you wherever you go? Yes, now you can and you are just at a click of a button away. 

Not only can you download any videos off from the Internet and other popular social media sites, but  you can also download the HIGH DEFINITION (HD) version of any videos in awesome quality whenever available. This makes us quite outstanding and unique from the rest of other similar apps.

This is quite useful for someone living in a region where the internet is not fast enough yet, and video buffering is rampant.

Some unique features that comes along with this app -
- Ability to download the HIGH DEFINITION (HD) version besides the STANDARD DEFINITION (SD) one.
- Availability of a wide range of video qualities to choose from besides HD and SD.
- Robust, reliable and fast.
- Ability to save the downloaded videos to your external SD card directly.
-  Simple, easy to use and very user friendly UI.
- Plus many more interesting features


IMPORTANT :
This app merely acts as a platform for browsing internet through a well defined user friendly UI using android web view component.
